skills.name: Vendetta
skills.description: Brings forth a burning hatred of goblins. Good effects on allies.  *Creates a shield over an area (4 sec) *HP x 30% Area Recovery (per sec) (7 sec) *HP +250% (7 sec)

skills.name: Scroll of Teleport
skills.description: A scroll connected to the bottom of the ocean. Bad effects on enemies.  *Cancels enemy invincibility skills  *Changes Dark elemental enemies to None (7 sec) *ATK x 3000% Area Damage

abilities.name: Group: Goblin Slayer
abilities.description: Goblin Slayer Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and ATK buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Persistence
abilities.description: Rangers with this Ability have a high chance of activating Persistence when defeated. Persistence allows these Rangers to hold on for 7 more seconds with a big ATK increase.
